title: Three-stage large language model training workflow
alt: Vertical workflow separating pretraining, supervised instruction tuning, and preference-based alignment stages for a large language model.
caption: A common three-stage schematic for pretraining, instruction tuning, and preference-based alignment; specific systems vary.
teachingUse: Makes pretraining and post-training visibly distinct so students do not treat the model as one undifferentiated process.
